text:
lina: Oreo has declared the antique teapot his personal perch. tiny aristocat energy. photo attached 
doggo-bot: uploaded image: oreo_teapot_throne.jpg (800x600) 
ezra: of course he did. the teapot throne returns. :joy: 
harper: we need a coronation. royal titles, go. 
marta: poll time: 1) Earl of Steeping 2) Duchess of Leaves 3) Sir Whiskerlot 
ezra: vote 2 
harper: vote 3. also i'll craft a tiny crown from felt + ribbon. 
lina: please felt not foil (foil attack of '22 still haunts me). tuna flakes accepted as tribute. :fish_cake: 
doggo-bot: reaction :crown: added by harper 
marta: @facilities can we source a micro-throne cushion? also logging in office-stories for social. 
ezra: i'll bring the ceremonial ribbon. harper, i volunteer as royal photographer. 
harper: excellent. ceremony scheduled for 'after-standup' tomorrow. attendees welcome. 
lina: quick PSA: do not pour tea while Oreo is inside teapot. it is a bad idea. learned that previously. :grimacing: 
marta: noted in office safety doc. :memo: 
ezra: adding "respect teapot monarchy" to team handbook (draft). 
doggo-bot: archived thread to photo-archive/2026/oreo_teapot_throne.jpg 
lina: Oreo blinks in approval and will accept gentle curtsies and virtual scones. :paw_prints:
